description: This file defines the TaskDescription class and companion object in Apache Spark, handling serialization and deserialization of task descriptions for executor communication, including resource and artifact management.

classes.name: TaskDescription
classes.description: Represents a task to be executed by Spark executors, including serialization logic.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Serializes a TaskDescription object into a ByteBuffer for transmission.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Deserializes a ByteBuffer into a TaskDescription object.
